meta_title: Why Choose SN Cleaning Services for Deep Cleaning
meta_description: No judgement, honest prices from photos and our own DBS checked team. Why homes across London and Essex choose SN Cleaning Services for a deep clean.
h1: No judgement, just a home that feels properly clean again
intro: Sometimes a home gets away from you. A new baby, long hours, an illness, a hard year, or simply years of everyday living. A deep clean gets you back to a fresh starting point, and for most people the hardest part is picking up the phone.

understand.heading: The part people don't say out loud
paragraphs: A lot of people who ask us about a deep clean start by apologising. They tell us the oven hasn't been done since they moved in, the grout has gone dark, or they've put off calling because they're embarrassed about how it looks. Please don't be. My team genuinely enjoy the dirty jobs, because they're the ones where you can see the difference you've made.

Other times it isn't about mess at all. Family are coming to stay, someone has been ill, the seasons are changing, or you want to start regular cleaning and need a proper baseline first. Either way, you want someone who'll get into the corners a normal clean skips, and who'll tell you honestly what it will take.
You don't have to describe it perfectly. Tell us in your own words, or send a few photos, and we'll give you an honest price.

different.heading: Why people trust us with the rooms they'd rather nobody saw

items.title: No judgement, ever
items.text: You won't be the first, and you won't get a lecture. You'll get a friendly team who are pleased to be there and want to see the change.

items.title: An honest price from photos
items.text: Describe the home or send photos and we price it on what's really there. Deep cleaning is charged by the hour, from £27 per cleaner per hour, and you agree the price before anything is booked.

items.title: We go where regular cleans don't
items.text: Grout and tiles, limescale, skirting boards, door frames, and behind and under furniture. Add the oven and we clean inside it too.

items.title: The whole home, or just the room that bothers you
items.text: Book every room, or only the ones that need it. Kitchens and bathrooms are the rooms people ask for most.

items.title: My own Limescale Remover
items.text: Bathrooms are where a deep clean shows. Alongside professional products for each surface, the team uses my own Limescale Remover on taps, screens and tiles.

items.title: Before and after photos
items.text: Our cleaners photograph the rooms before and after, and you get a private link with Before and After folders, so you can see exactly what was done.

process.heading: How a deep clean with us works

steps.title: Tell us about your home
steps.text: Let us know which rooms you want done and what's bothering you most. Photos help, but a few honest sentences work just as well.

steps.title: Get an honest price
steps.text: We work out how many hours the job needs, based on the size and condition of the home. Larger homes may have more than one cleaner. You see and agree the price before booking.

steps.title: Choose your day
steps.text: Pick a date that suits you, and mention pets, allergies or anything you'd like left alone.

steps.title: The deep clean
steps.text: The team takes before photos, then works top to bottom through each room, including the edges, corners and hidden spots, and finishes with after photos for your private link.

steps.title: Check it, then keep it that way
steps.text: Walk round and look. If you'd like, we can then set up weekly, fortnightly or monthly cleaning so the home stays where the deep clean left it.

promise.heading: You're not taking a chance on us
paragraphs: The price is agreed before you book, based on what you've told us or shown us. If the home turns out to need something different from what we discussed, we talk to you first.
If you're not happy with any part of the clean, tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean that area free of charge.
Every cleaner is from our own team: trained, insured and DBS checked, never a subcontractor. When you let someone into a home you've felt awkward about, you should know exactly who they are.

proof.heading: Where our eye for detail comes from
proof.paragraph: SN Cleaning Services started as a regular domestic cleaning company. Then we added end of tenancy cleaning, and for four years it made up about 95% of our bookings. Cleaning thousands of homes to the standard an inventory clerk checks against taught us where dirt hides, and that's the experience we brought into deep and heavy duty cleaning. After 12 years cleaning homes in London and Essex, there's very little we haven't seen.

faqs.question: How much will my deep clean cost in total?
faqs.answer: Deep cleaning is charged by the hour, from £27 per cleaner per hour, so the total depends on how long your home needs. Tell us about the rooms and their condition, or send photos, and we'll give you a price to agree before you book.

faqs.question: Can I send photos instead of describing my home?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it often helps. A few photos of the kitchen, bathroom and any problem areas let us see what's really there and give you an honest price. Nobody is judging the photos, they're just there to get the price right.

faqs.question: My home is in a really bad state. Will you still take it on?
faqs.answer: Yes. People are often embarrassed, and there's no need to be. We also do heavy duty cleans for homes that need more than a standard deep clean. Tell us about it or send photos and we'll be straight with you about what it needs.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a deep clean and a heavy duty clean?
faqs.answer: A deep clean goes beyond a regular clean into grout, limescale, skirting and behind furniture. A heavy duty clean is for homes where things have built up much further. If you're not sure which you need, describe the home or send photos and we'll advise.

faqs.question: How long does a deep clean take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the size of the home, how many rooms you want done and their condition. A single bathroom is a very different job from a whole house. We'll tell you how many hours we expect when we give you the price.

faqs.question: Will more than one cleaner come?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. For larger homes or bigger jobs we may send more than one cleaner so the work gets done in a sensible time. Remember the hourly rate is per cleaner, and we'll explain the plan when we price it.

faqs.question: Is the inside of the oven included?
faqs.answer: The oven is cleaned inside when you add it to your deep clean. Just mention it when you book, along with anything else you'd like included, so we can allow the time for it.

faqs.question: Do you clean inside the fridge and cupboards?
faqs.answer: We can. Inside the fridge and kitchen cupboards is done on request, so let us know when you book. It helps if they're emptied beforehand so the team can clean every shelf.

faqs.question: Can you get rid of mould in the bathroom?
faqs.answer: We treat mould where it's present on bathroom surfaces as part of a deep clean. If mould keeps coming back, it's often a damp or ventilation issue that cleaning alone can't fix, and we'll be honest with you about that.

faqs.question: Can you remove heavy limescale from taps and shower screens?
faqs.answer: That's one of our favourite jobs. We use professional products and my own Limescale Remover on taps, shower screens, tiles and fittings. Very old build up may need more than one treatment, and we'll tell you if so.

faqs.question: Do you clean behind and under furniture?
faqs.answer: Yes, where it's accessible. That's where dust and allergens collect most. If there's a very heavy piece of furniture, like a wardrobe or a large sofa, mention it when you book so we know what to expect.

faqs.question: What should I do before the deep clean?
faqs.answer: Clear away clutter, clothes and personal items where you can, so the hours go on cleaning rather than tidying. Empty anything you'd like cleaned inside, and tell us about any delicate surfaces or areas to avoid.

faqs.question: Do I need to be at home during the clean?
faqs.answer: That's up to you. Some people like to be there at the start to show the team round. If you won't be in, tell us when you book how we'll get into the property.

faqs.question: I have pets. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: Not at all. Let us know what pets you have when you book. It helps if they're kept in one room or out of the way while the team cleans, especially around wet floors and open doors.

faqs.question: Do you bring your own products and equipment?
faqs.answer: We bring professional products chosen for each surface, including my own Limescale Remover. If you'd like us to bring equipment such as a vacuum and mop as well, mention it when you book and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Are your cleaners insured and DBS checked?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every cleaner is part of our own team, trained by us, insured and DBS checked. We never use subcontractors, so we always know who is in your home. That matters when you are letting someone into your home.

faqs.question: Will I get before and after photos?
faqs.answer: Yes. On deep cleans our cleaners photograph the rooms before and after, and you get a private link with Before and After folders. You can see the difference side by side.

faqs.question: What if I'm not happy with part of the clean?
faqs.answer: Tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re clean that area free of charge. Let us know which room and what isn't right, and photos help us put it right first time.

faqs.question: Can I book a deep clean before moving into a new home?
faqs.answer: Yes. A deep clean before you unpack is a good way to start fresh in a new home, because the rooms are empty and every corner is easy to reach. Tell us it's a move in when you book.

faqs.question: Can I move to regular cleaning after the deep clean?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many people use a deep clean as the starting point and then book weekly, fortnightly or monthly visits. Regular visits cost less per hour than a one off clean, and we try to send the same cleaner each time.

faqs.question: Do you deep clean carpets as part of this?
faqs.answer: Carpets are vacuumed thoroughly as part of a deep clean. Professional carpet cleaning with hot water extraction is a separate service you can book alongside it, so the floors match the rest of the home.

faqs.question: Which areas do you cover?
faqs.answer: We deep clean homes across London and Essex, from our office in Brentwood. Enter your postcode in the quote form to check your address. If you are not sure, ask our team and they will check for you.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel my booking?
faqs.answer: Contact our team as soon as you know your plans have changed and they'll explain the options for your booking. The sooner you get in touch, the easier it is to find another day that works for you and your home.

faqs.question: Can I talk to someone first?
faqs.answer: Of course, if you'd rather talk it through first. Our customer support team is available Monday to Friday from 7am to 10pm, and Saturday and Sunday from 8am to 5pm.
